checks.name: T1_split_stabilizer_dim2

checks.name: T1_trace_condition_fully_invariant
checks.note: tr[lam, X] = 0 identically for generic lam in so(1,3) and generic class member: the det-one condition tr X = a + d = 0 is the unique stratum condition covariant under the FULL gauge algebra

checks.name: T1_so2_fixed_set_is_isotropic_line
checks.note: [R23, X] = 0 within the class iff b=0, C=0, a=d: the EXACT fixed-point set of the residual screen so(2) is the isotropic line X_lambda = diag(-1,+1,lambda,lambda) -- reproduces the CITED SO(2)-screen row of the joint no-go table (07-28)

checks.name: T1_diagonal_subfamily_not_so2_stable
checks.note: [R23, diag(-1,1,a,d)] has symmetric off-diagonal screen entries (a-d): the diagonal (a,d) subfamily is a chart section, so(2)-stable only on its isotropic diagonal a=d

checks.name: T1_so2_invariants_tr_det_antisym
checks.note: under the residual so(2) conjugation the invariant content of the screen generator K is exactly (tr K, det K, antisymmetric part)

checks.name: T1_e07_k_sign_is_chart
checks.note: a pi/2 screen rotation conjugates diag(-k,+k) -> diag(+k,-k): the SIGN of the E07 modulus k is chart gauge; the invariant is (tr K = 0, det K = -k^2), i.e. |k|

checks.name: T2_bracket_block_formula
checks.note: [X1,X2] = [[0,0],[(C1-C2)H + K1C2 - K2C1, [K1,K2]]] exactly: the bracket of two class members has ZERO base block -- it points OUT of the affine class (base coefficient 1) into its linear part

checks.name: T2_K_bracket_stays_triangular
checks.note: [K1,K2] is again upper triangular (triangular 2x2 = solvable subalgebra): the angular chart condition is bracket-stable

checks.name: T2_K_bracket_nonabelian_witness
checks.note: [K1,K2]_[0,1] = a*b2 + b*d2 - a2*b - b2*d: nonzero generically -- E05/E03/E02 are non-abelian strata (b-direction active)

checks.name: T2_L8_is_lie_algebra
checks.note: the 8-dim envelope L8 = {[[s*H,0],[C,K_triangular]]} closes as a Lie algebra with the bracket's s-component = 0: class exponentials generate exp(L8), an 8-dim group, NOT the class itself

checks.name: T2_nonclosure_witness_base_identity
checks.note: exp(-phi*X_{d=1})*exp(phi*X_{a=1}) has base block = identity exactly

checks.name: T2_nonclosure_witness_not_class_form
checks.note: its screen block is diag(e^phi, e^-phi) != I for phi != 0, but any class element exp(psi*X) with base = I forces psi = 0 hence = I: EXACT witness that the stratum exponential sets (all strata with >= 2 members) are not closed under composition at total phi = 0

checks.name: T2_diagonal_subfamily_abelian
checks.note: [diag(-1,1,a1,d1), diag(-1,1,a2,d2)] = 0: the diagonal subfamily (E07 line and isotropic line included) is abelian -- zero BCH obstruction; only the affine renormalization failure remains

checks.name: T2_diagonal_composition_renormalized_modulus
checks.note: for phi1+phi2 != 0 the diagonal product IS class form, with modulus abar = (phi1*a1 + phi2*a2)/(phi1+phi2): a phi-weighted mean -- the composed modulus is HISTORY-DEPENDENT unless a1=a2, d1=d2

checks.name: T2_diagonal_modulus_shift_vanishes_iff_equal
checks.note: abar - a1 = phi2*(a2-a1)/(phi1+phi2) = 0 iff a2 = a1 (phi2 != 0): a CONSTANT modulus assignment survives composition only if every segment carries the same member (J07/J11-typed requirement)

checks.name: T3_E08_finite_form_is_exponential
checks.note: g(phi,s): dg/dphi = X_s g, g(0) = I -- the E08 finite form IS exp(phi*X_s) by linear-ODE uniqueness (matches the banked E08 entry s*(1 - e^-phi))

checks.name: T3_shift_cocycle_law
checks.note: composition (phi1 then phi2, product g2*g1): the cross entry obeys sigma_tot = sigma1 + e^{-phi1}*sigma2 with sigma = s*(1-e^{-phi}) -- an exact affine 1-cocycle of the reciprocal channel valued in the weight e^{-phi} module (ax+b-type composition)

checks.name: T3_cocycle_associativity
checks.note: triple composition: sigma_123 = sigma1 + e^{-phi1} sigma2 + e^{-phi1-phi2} sigma3 -- associative, path-ordered weights

checks.name: T3_class_form_recovered_off_zero_total
checks.note: for phi1+phi2 != 0 the product equals g(phi1+phi2, sbar) with sbar = [sigma1 + e^{-phi1} sigma2]/(1 - e^{-(phi1+phi2)}): class form survives but the shift modulus composes non-trivially

checks.name: T3_same_s_consistency
checks.note: s1 = s2 = s gives sbar = s exactly: single-member segments compose within one one-parameter subgroup, as they must

checks.name: T3_history_dependence_witness
checks.note: sbar at (T/2, T/2) minus sbar at (T, 0) = (s2-s1)*e^{-T/2}*(1-e^{-T/2})/(1-e^{-T}) != 0 unless s1=s2: the composed shift depends on the phi-HISTORY, not only on the total phi

checks.name: T3_general_C_finite_form
checks.note: exp(phi*[[H,0],[C,0]]) = [[e^{phi H},0],[C*M(phi), I]] with M(phi) = diag(1-e^{-phi}, e^{phi}-1) exactly (E08 is its s11 axis)

checks.name: T3_general_C_cocycle
checks.note: lower-left of the composition = C2*M(phi2)*e^{phi1 H} + C1*M(phi1): the full mixing block composes by the same path-ordered affine cocycle, channel-weighted by e^{-phi1} (clock leg) and e^{+phi1} (ruler leg)

checks.name: T3_M_invertible_iff_phi_nonzero
checks.note: det M(phi) = (1-e^{-phi})(e^{phi}-1) = 0 iff phi = 0: off total phi = 0 the composed Cbar = [C2 M(phi2) e^{phi1 H} + C1 M(phi1)]*M(phi1+phi2)^{-1} exists uniquely (class form with history-dependent mixing modulus)

checks.name: T3_zero_total_residual_C1_minus_C2
checks.note: at phi2 = -phi1 the residual lower-left is (C1 - C2)*M(phi1): nonzero unless C1 = C2 -- the finite E04-family witness of non-closure at total phi = 0

checks.name: T3_first_order_C_bracket
checks.note: [X_C1, X_C2] = [[0,0],[(C1-C2)H, 0]] exactly: two mixing directions fail to commute at first order iff C1 != C2, the infinitesimal seed of the finite cocycle (H invertible => (C1-C2)H = 0 iff C1 = C2)

checks.name: T4_diagonal_finite_form
checks.note: exp(phi*diag(-1,1,a,d)) = diag(e^{-phi}, e^{phi}, e^{a phi}, e^{d phi})

checks.name: T4_E07_sign_check

checks.name: T4_4d_volume_exponent_a_plus_d

checks.name: T4_det_one_line
checks.note: det exp(phi X) = e^{(a+d)phi} and tr X = a + d (ledger E03 fact): the det-one line is a + d = 0

checks.name: T4_three_name_coincidence
checks.note: the E07 line (a,d) = (-k,+k), the det-one line a+d=0, and the 4D chart volume-blind locus a+d=0 are ONE line (the anti-diagonal of the (a,d) plane)

checks.name: T4_lambda_k_coordinates
checks.note: (a,d) = (lambda-k, lambda+k) with lambda = (a+d)/2, k = (d-a)/2: the isotropic seat and the E07 seat are the two ORTHOGONAL axes of the diagonal plane, meeting only at the spectator origin -- the MAP's seat equation 'E07 k = joint-audit lambda' is resolved as a DECOMPOSITION, not an identity

checks.name: T4_isotropic_4d_exponent_2lambda
checks.note: on the isotropic line the 4D chart volume exponent is 2*lambda (blind at lambda = 0, the spectator)

checks.name: T4_orbit_exponent_reconciliation
checks.note: the CITED 3D orbit-volume exponent 1+2*lambda (rank-closure audit 07-27) = two screen legs at lambda plus ONE fibre leg at ruler weight +1; blind at lambda = -1/2.  It is a DIFFERENT functional on a DIFFERENT space (S3 orbit of the stationary branch) from the 4D chart volume (exponent a+d, clock and ruler cancelling): the two blind loci (a+d=0 vs lambda=-1/2) must NOT be conflated; the lambda=-1/2 pin translates to the (a,d) plane ONLY as the point (-1/2,-1/2) on the isotropic line, scope-stamped to that branch

checks.name: T4_conditional_pins_on_isotropic_line
checks.note: the three CITED conditional pins -- SO(3)->(+1,+1), SO+(1,2)->(-1,-1), swap->(0,0) (07-27/07-28 audits) -- all lie on the isotropic axis k=0; no banked gate pins any point with k != 0

headline_structure.T1: strata are SPLIT-RELATIVE: full so(1,3) preserves only the trace (det-one) condition; the base/angular split is preserved by so(1,1)+so(2) (dim 2); fixed founded H cuts to so(2) (dim 1); the triangular chart cuts to {0}; the so(2)-fixed set inside the class is exactly the isotropic line; so(2)-invariant content of K is (tr, det, antisym)
headline_structure.T2: no stratum with >= 2 members closes under composition at total phi = 0 (exact witness); off that locus composition closes with HISTORY-DEPENDENT moduli (phi-weighted mean in the abelian diagonal subfamily; BCH/cocycle in the non-abelian strata); class exponentials generate the 8-dim exp(L8)
headline_structure.T3: mixing shift is an exact affine 1-cocycle: sigma_tot = sigma1 + e^{-phi1} sigma2 (channel-weighted, path-ordered, associative); class form recoverable off total phi = 0 with history-dependent sbar; first-order seed [X_C1,X_C2] = [[0,0],[(C1-C2)H,0]]
headline_structure.T4: (a,d) = (lambda-k, lambda+k); E07 line = det-one line = 4D volume-blind line (one anti-diagonal); isotropic line = so(2)-fixed axis carrying all three conditional pins (+1/-1/0) and the branch-scoped orbit-volume-blind point (-1/2,-1/2); 4D chart volume exponent = a+d (derived natively), distinct from the cited 3D orbit exponent 1+2*lambda
